gates.name: Parity with the reference pipeline (parsing, contact map, energies, deterministic and injected-noise trajectories, nucleic thermodynamics)
gates.detail: cargo test: tests/nucleic_parity.rs 9/9 and tests/protein_parity.rs 10/10 against expected.json / expected_protein.json exported from the reference (energies 1e-9, trajectories at T=0 and with injected reference noise).

gates.name: Production force field equals reference force field (1TIT, 1UBQ, 2GB1; 21 conformations each)
gates.detail: src/fast.rs fast_force_equals_reference_force: 1TIT, 1UBQ, 2GB1 x 21 conformations; energy within 1e-9, force within 1e-5 of force scale.

gates.name: Statistical equivalence of trajectories with the reference (protocol G1, 30 replicas per engine)
gates.detail: Reference runs in progress (the Python reference needs ≈ 1 s per step).

gates.name: Ubiquitin: N–C stronger than K48–C
gates.detail: N–C 11.78 vs K48–C 5.98 ε/Å, one-sided Mann–Whitney p = 3.4e-8. Caveat: N–C also spans more chain (drag).

gates.name: GFP: strong pulling directions above weak ones, Spearman ρ ≥ 0.7 with experiment
gates.detail: ρ = -0.80; strong above weak: false. Peak tension follows the pulled span (drag), not the measured strength.

gates.name: Nucleic structures against ViennaRNA (100 random sequences)
gates.detail: Pre-declared: needs a secondary-structure folding algorithm, which the engine does not have; the simulator accepts only perfect stems.

gates.name: DNA hairpins against experiment (20-bp, 55 % GC class; Woodside et al. 2006)
gates.detail: Median F½ 18.5 pN (target 13.2 ± 3.0): fail; median Δx 16.4 nm (target 18 ± 20 %): pass; F½ rises with GC: pass.

gates.name: Native and WebAssembly (Chrome) give byte-identical results
Two runs in Chrome are byte-identical
gates.detail: Two fresh workers in Chrome: identical hashes.

gates.name: Firefox and Safari
gates.detail: Neither browser is available on the test machine. Expected identical: all floating-point maths, including transcendental functions, is inside the WebAssembly module.

gates.name: Titin I27 standard run (3 speeds × 10 replicas) under 60 s in Chrome
gates.detail: I27 standard (30 trajectories): 168.7 s with 12 workers in Chrome 155.0.8059.40; talin R3 (2L7A, 125 residues) standard: 372.2 s; I27 quick: 15.6 s.

gates.name: Phone performance
gates.detail: No phone available; phones are limited to the Quick protocol.
